title: Baseline vocabulary in context
instructions: Choose the meaning that best fits each independent sentence. Complete all five before submitting the protected form.

parts.prompt: The instructions were concise: they covered every necessary step in only four short sentences. What does “concise” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.A: The instructions are described by length and completeness.
choice_rationales.B: Four short sentences cover all required steps.

parts.hint: Protected baseline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Concise means expressing what is needed in few words.

parts.prompt: When the footpath flooded again, residents proposed a durable solution rather than another repair that would fail after one season. What does “durable” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.C: It contrasts with a short-lived repair.

parts.hint: Protected baseline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Durable means able to withstand use or time.

parts.prompt: The witness gave a vague description, mentioning only ‘a tall person’ without clothing, direction or time. What does “vague” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.A: The examples show missing identifying information.

parts.hint: Protected baseline: no hint is available.

parts.prompt: The committee was reluctant to close the playground; members delayed the vote and asked whether repairs were possible. What does “reluctant” most nearly mean?
parts.hint: Protected baseline: no hint is available.

parts.prompt: Although the first seedling trial failed, the class remained resilient and designed a revised test the following week. What does “resilient” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.B: They continue with a revised test.

parts.hint: Protected baseline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Resilient people recover and continue after setbacks.
